builds.title: Firesoul Genasi forge ward, Swordmage 1
traits: Fortitude 12, Reflex 15, Will 12. Bloodied 14. Ten healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor and a longsword in one hand. Swordmage Warding gives +3 AC with the other hand free, +1 with a blade and no free hand. The ward applies while conscious and wielding a blade.
Firesoul grants fire resistance 5 and contributes +1 Reflex. Firepulse uses Strength.
Retributive Shield grants +2 to the next attack against the foe whose attack triggered Aegis of Shielding, through the end of Avarra’s next turn.
actions: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +5 vs. AC, 1d8+2 damage.
Greenflame Blade, at-will standard. Melee 1, +7 vs. AC, 1d8+4 fire. On a hit each enemy adjacent to the target takes 2 fire.
Sword Burst, at-will standard. Close burst 1, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 force.
Flame Cyclone, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each creature, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+6 fire.
Frost Backlash, daily immediate interrupt when an adjacent creature hits Avarra. Melee 1, +7 vs. Reflex for 3d8+4 cold, half on a miss.

Aegis of Shielding, at-will minor, close burst 2, marks a creature until another Aegis target or a superseding mark. Attacks that omit Avarra take −2. When such an attack hits and that foe is within 10 squares, immediate interrupt to reduce its damage to one creature by 7.
Firepulse, encounter immediate reaction after an enemy within 1 square hits Avarra with a melee attack. +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+2 fire.
builds.tactics: Marks the creature blocking the exit, using her immediate action to shield a worker or answer a melee hit. Keeps the blast pointed away from the crew.

builds.title: Kalashtar dream mediator, Cleric 1
builds.senses: Normal vision, passive Insight 21 and Perception 14
traits: Fortitude 11, Reflex 11, Will 16. Bloodied 14. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each. Chainmail, holy symbol, and Toughness.
Uses Diplomacy for the flexible +2 racial skill bonus. Makes Dual Soul saves at turn start, with no turn-end retry for a failed early save.
Healer’s Lore adds +4 to healing granted by a cleric power that makes the target spend a surge. Follows the Path of Light. Ritual Casting grants Gentle Repose and Comprehend Language.
actions: Mace basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +3 vs. AC for 1d8+1 damage.
Lance of Faith, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant and one ally Sena sees gets +2 power bonus on its next attack against the target.
Sacred Flame, at-will standard. Ranged 5, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4 radiant. One visible ally can save or gain 3 temporary HP.
Divine Glow, encounter standard. Close blast 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Reflex for 1d8+4 radiant. Allies in the blast get +2 power bonus to attacks until the end of Sena’s next turn.

Beacon of Hope, daily standard. Close burst 3, each enemy, +4 vs. Will to weaken it through the end of its next turn. Sena and allies in the burst regain 5 HP, and her healing powers heal 5 more through the encounter.
Healing Word, encounter minor, twice per encounter and once per round. In close burst 5, Sena or an ally spends a surge and regains 1d6+4 more HP.

Channel Divinity, choose either power once per encounter. Divine Fortune is free and gives +1 to the next attack or save through the end of Sena’s next turn. Turn Undead is standard, close burst 2, +4 vs. Will against each undead for 1d10+4 radiant, pushing 6 and immobilizing through the end of Sena’s next turn. Miss for half damage only.

Bastion of Mental Clarity, encounter immediate interrupt when an enemy hits or misses Sena against Will. Sena and allies in close burst 5 gain +4 power bonus to Will through the end of Sena’s next turn.
builds.tactics: Keeps allies in reach of her telepathy and defends their Will against a shared threat. Opens with Divine Glow when the group can stay close.

builds.title: Mul caravan shield, Fighter 1
traits: Fortitude 16, Reflex 13, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Thirteen healing surges, worth 7 each, including Mul Vitality.
Scale armor, heavy shield, and longsword. One-Handed Fighter Weapon Talent adds +1 to attacks. Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with heavy blades.
Born of Two Races choice is dwarf. Tireless requires 6 hours of sleep per 72 hours for an extended rest.

Combat Challenge can mark each target Daro attacks through the end of his next turn. A mark penalizes attacks omitting him by −2. If his adjacent marked foe shifts or attacks without targeting him, immediate interrupt for a melee basic attack.
Combat Superiority gives +1 to opportunity attacks. A hit stops the movement that provoked it.
actions: Longsword basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC, 1d8+5 damage. As an opportunity attack, +9.
Cleave, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5 and 4 damage to another enemy adjacent to Daro on a hit.
Tide of Iron, at-will standard using a shield. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d8+5. Push the target 1 if Large or smaller, then Daro can shift into its former square.
Covering Attack, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5 and lets an ally adjacent to the target shift 2.

Villain’s Menace, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 2d8+5, with +2 power bonus to attacks and +4 to damage versus that foe through the encounter. Miss gains +1 to attacks and +2 to damage against it instead.
Incredible Toughness, encounter, no action at turn start. End ongoing damage or a dazed, slowed, stunned, or weakened condition.
builds.tactics: Uses Tide of Iron to regain the choke point. Saves Incredible Toughness for a turn when a condition would keep him from covering the caravan.

builds.title: Thri-kreen clutch scout, Ranger 1
traits: Fortitude 13, Reflex 15, Will 11. Bloodied 13. Eight healing surges, worth 6 each.
Leather armor and longbow. A walking spear is backup. Archery style grants Defensive Mobility, for AC 18 against opportunity attacks.
Weapon Focus adds +1 damage with bows. Prime Shot adds +1 to a ranged attack if none of K’tcha’s allies is closer to the target.
Hunter’s Quarry, minor, designates the nearest visible enemy and adds 1d6 once per round on a hit against it.
Multiple Arms changes one minor item interaction to free each turn. Natural Jumper counts every jump as a running start. Four-hour aware torpor suffices for rest.
actions: Longbow basic attack, standard. Range 20/40, +6 vs. AC, 1d10+5 damage.
Spear basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +4 vs. AC for 1d8+2.
Twin Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, +6 vs. AC twice against one or two creatures, 1d10+1 per hit.
Nimble Strike, at-will standard. Longbow, shift 1 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 1d10+5.
Evasive Strike, encounter standard. Longbow, shift up to 2 before or after the attack, +6 vs. AC for 2d10+5.
Split the Tree, daily standard. Longbow against two creatures within 3 squares of each other. Make two +6 attacks and compare the higher roll to both ACs. Deal 2d10+5 to each hit.
Thri-Kreen Claws, encounter minor. Melee 1 against one to three enemies, +7 vs. AC for 1d8+4 plus the number targeted, even if not all attacks hit.
builds.tactics: Shoots from the edge of a gap. Uses the rapid draw to keep moving, then spends the minor claw power if cornered by several enemies.

builds.title: Bladeling gate sentinel, Rogue 1
builds.senses: Normal vision, passive Insight 16 and Perception 16
traits: Fortitude 12, Reflex 16, Will 11. Bloodied 15. Seven healing surges, worth 7 each.
Leather armor, dagger, and Toughness. Artful Dodger gives AC 17 against opportunity attacks. Extra +1 weapon talent attack with a dagger.
Resist acid 5 at level 1. Razor Storm uses Dexterity to attack.

First Strike grants combat advantage against creatures yet to act in round one. Once per turn under the rules update, an eligible dagger hit against a target granting combat advantage adds 2d6 Sneak Attack damage.
actions: Dagger basic attack, standard. Melee 1, +6 vs. AC for 1d4+2 damage.
Sly Flourish, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+5.
Piercing Strike, at-will standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. Reflex for 1d4+4.
Dazing Strike, encounter standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 1d4+4 and dazes the target through the end of Varik’s next turn.
Trick Strike, daily standard. Melee 1, +8 vs. AC for 3d4+4 and slides the target 1. On a hit against that target later this encounter, slide it 1.
Razor Storm, encounter minor. Close burst 1 against each creature, +6 vs. Reflex for 1d6+4.
builds.tactics: Feints to separate an intruder from the porters. Uses Razor Storm only after allies clear his immediate reach.

concepts.name: Avarra Coalwake
concepts.motive: Keep onlookers clear while the forge crew shutters a ruptured flue.
concepts.hook: Avarra draws a longsword and points the crew toward the safer door.

concepts.name: Sena Varan
concepts.motive: Talk an ally out of entering a dangerous shared dream.
concepts.hook: Sena communicates a warning telepathically before she speaks out loud.

concepts.name: Daro Stonehand
concepts.motive: Hold a choke point while the caravan gets its animals clear.
concepts.hook: Daro plants his shield at the narrowest part of the route and asks for an opening signal.

concepts.name: K’tcha
concepts.motive: Guide the clutch across a break in the trail before the wind erases the route.
concepts.hook: K’tcha points out a gap in the rock and demonstrates the jump with a quick bound.

concepts.name: Varik Ashsteel
concepts.motive: Clear the gate mouth so the porters can move their carts through.
concepts.hook: Varik calls the porters behind him and looks for space to clear the opening.
